intended_object: The monodromy map from isomorphism classes of degree-n Belyi pairs (X, β) to isomorphism classes (simultaneous conjugacy classes) of permutation triples (σ0, σ1, σ∞) in S_n with product 1. It sends a pair to the monodromy of the covering of ℂ∖{0,1} around 0, 1 and ∞. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The definition starts from a representative pair of degree n. It restricts β to a covering of the thrice-punctured sphere, numbers the fibre over the base point 1/2 by Fin n, and takes the monodromy triple of that covering. Its value is the class of this triple in `PermutationTriple.IsoClass n`, i.e. the triple up to relabelling the sheets.

`Quotient.lift` is justified by `Iso.isoClass_monodromyTriple_eq`: isomorphic pairs have isomorphic monodromy triples. `toIsoClass_mk` shows the class does not depend on how the fibre is numbered. This is exactly the standard monodromy map in the Grothendieck/Belyi correspondence (Girondo–González-Diez §4.3).

The setting is the thrice-punctured sphere and permutations of Fin n. That is intrinsic to the notion of a Belyi pair and of a permutation triple, so the definition is not too narrow. Mathlib has no counterpart: it has no Belyi pairs, dessins d'enfants or permutation triples.
